Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
Urinalysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), leukocyturia, nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of hematuria and low specific gravity are noted. Marked glucosuria without ketonuria may suggest hyperglycemia/diabetes. Recommend clinical correlation for UTI and evaluation for possible diabetes mellitus.
